From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Riya Patel <riya.patel@northwindfinancial.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@northwindfinancial.com>
Date: Fri, Nov 7, 2025 at 9:14 AM PT
Subject: Shadow Evals beta (Shadow Traffic) - Northwind Financial x Redwood

Riya —

Thanks again for the upgrade discussion yesterday. Based on what you shared (need to compare candidate model versions against your real production traffic, without impacting responses), I’d like to invite Northwind into our “Shadow Evals” beta.

What it is (in one line): we mirror a sampled subset of live requests to one or more “shadow targets” (candidate model/version/config), run them asynchronously (never blocks the primary request), and surface quality + latency/cost deltas in Console with guardrails you can use for rollout gating.

If you’re interested, I’d suggest a 30-min beta kickoff next week to align on:
- Routes to shadow + sampling % (start small; typical 0.1–1%)
- Shadow target(s): the model/version(s) you want to evaluate
- Success criteria (quality + perf thresholds) and your review cadence
- Data controls (retention, redaction, residency) and any internal approvals

Tentative timeline on our side:
- Beta enablement window: week of Nov 17
- 2–3 weeks to collect enough signal for the first decision (depending on traffic volume and sampling)

Can you do Tue 11/11 or Wed 11/12 sometime between 10a–2p PT?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Console & Rollouts
Redwood Inference

Marissa,

Yes — we’re interested.

We have two chat routes we’d want to evaluate for the Q4 model refresh:
1) /support-assistant (high volume)
2) /advisor-notes (lower volume, but more sensitive)

A few initial constraints/questions:
- We can start with /support-assistant only if that helps reduce risk.
- Our primary concern is “no customer impact.” Please confirm shadowing can’t affect the primary response even under overload.
- For success criteria, we care about structured output adherence (JSON schema) and safety policy outcomes at least as much as judge preference.
- On data: we likely need 7–14 days retention max, with redaction of PII (names, account numbers). We’ll need to understand residency (US-only).

Wed 11/12 at 11:00 AM PT works.

Riya
Director, Applied AI
Northwind Financial

Subject: Re: Shadow Evals beta (Shadow Traffic) - Northwind Financial x Redwood

Perfect — booked for Wed 11/12 at 11:00 AM PT (invite coming separately).

Quick answers + a draft mutual action plan (MAP):

1) “No customer impact” guarantee
- Shadow execution is async and explicitly non-blocking.
- If shadow capacity is constrained, we drop shadow work first (rate limits + queue backpressure). Primary path continues normally.
- We also have a global kill switch and per-route disable control we can toggle without deploy.

2) Suggested beta scope (to start)
- Start with /support-assistant only
- Sampling: 0.2% for 48 hours → 1% if SLOs look clean
- Shadow targets: 1 candidate model upgrade + (optional) 1 quantization profile

3) Draft success criteria (we can tune)
Quality (shadow vs current):
- Structured output: JSON schema valid rate within 0.5% of baseline
- Safety: policy pass rate non-degraded (no increase in “block” or “review” outcomes)
- Judge: preference / win-rate not worse than -3% relative (with confidence interval noted)
Performance / cost:
- Shadow-only metrics: latency + cost deltas tracked; primary p99 latency must remain unchanged (we can share perf canary results)
- Shadow budget: cap GPU/time cost per route (we’ll set defaults)

4) Data controls
- US region only
- Retention configurable; default 7 days for beta (can go lower)
- Redaction: config-driven allowlist + PII filters (we can walk through what gets stored vs hashed)

MAP draft (feel free to comment inline): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NW-ShadowEvals-MAP-Example/edit

Attaching a one-pager to forward internally.

Attachment: Redwood Shadow Evals Beta - One Pager.pdf

Marissa

Marissa,

Jumping in from security side.

A few things we’ll need clarity on before we can run anything with production prompts:

1) What exactly is persisted for shadow runs?
- Is prompt text stored? Are model outputs stored? Or only derived metrics?

2) Access controls
- Who at Redwood can access raw payloads (if any)? Is access logged?

3) Retention + residency
- You mentioned US-only and configurable retention. Is “0 days” (metrics only) supported?
- Are any logs replicated outside the US for monitoring?

4) Redaction
- If your PII filter misses something, can we opt to avoid storing payloads entirely and still compute judge metrics?

If you can send a short written response we can pre-read before the Wed call, that’d help.

Thanks,
Tom Alvarez

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@northwindfinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Riya Patel <riya.patel@northwindfinancial.com>
Date: Wed, Nov 12, 2025 at 9:32 AM PT
Subject: Re: Shadow Evals beta (Shadow Traffic) - Northwind Financial x Redwood

Tom — thanks, and glad you’re asking these up front.

Below is the concise version; we can go deeper on the call.

1) What is persisted?
We support three configurations (per route / per shadow policy):
A) Metrics-only (no raw payload persistence)
- We store aggregated metrics and non-sensitive identifiers needed for joining (e.g., request_id, route name, model target, timestamps) plus computed scores (schema-valid boolean, safety outcome, judge score).
- We do NOT persist prompt text or model output text.

B) Redacted payload samples (limited)
- Optional, explicitly enabled. Payload fields are redacted via configured allowlists and PII filters before storage.
- Intended for debugging prompt/output regressions when metrics indicate an issue.

C) Full payload storage is not the default and is generally discouraged for regulated workloads.

2) Access controls + audit
- Access to any stored payload samples (if enabled) is restricted to a small on-call/security-approved group.
- Access is logged and reviewed; we can provide audit evidence during your vendor review.

3) Retention + residency
- Retention is configurable. “0 days / metrics only” is supported.
- For US-only: shadow evaluation storage + processing remains in US regions when configured.
- We do not replicate raw payloads outside the configured region. Platform monitoring contains service-level metrics (not prompt/output content) and is also region-scoped for this feature.

4) Redaction failure mode
- If you’re concerned about any PII leakage risk, start with metrics-only (A).
- Judge scoring can still run without persistent storage; it operates on the transient shadow output in the execution path and only emits the resulting score.

If you have an internal questionnaire format you prefer (SIG, CAIQ, etc.), send it over and we’ll respond in that format as well.

Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Product Lead
Redwood Inference
